summary: XCHG Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of 7,000,000 ADSs at $0.625 per ADS, raising $4.375 million in gross proceeds for working capital. The transaction is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation; the company issued securities under an existing shelf registration statement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners as placement agent. No change of control, strategic review, or other event-driven category is present. The filing does not trigger a special-situations classification.
